A ﬂexible closed cell, cost eﬀective, elastomeric foam material suitable for 
use on hot and chilled water lines with limited UV and good weather 
resistance. This product is highly ﬂexible and provides a neat appearance 
when ﬁtted to exposed water lines.  
Material: Nitrile composite, closed cell foam
Density: 50kg – 55kg/m3 nominal
Service Temperature: -50°C to +110°C continuous
Thermal Conductivity W/mK 0.036 @ 23°C
Ozone Resistance Good 
UV Resistance Select E-Flex HT
Weather Resistance Good
Flexibility: Excellent
Flammability: AS1530.3:1999 - BS476 parts 6&7 Class 0

•General plumbing 
•HVAC/Refrigeration 
•Air Conditioning

Smoke developed 4 (range 0-10)
E-flex ST should not be used in high UV degradation environments. Please specify E-Flex HT for weather resistance profiles. It is the customer's responsibility 
to determine if this product is fit for purpose, given the conditions of the intended application.
Specification Guidelines
Where general plumbing insulation is required and surrounded by a weather-resistant enclosure or 
not exposed to the weather, the insulation shall be Thermotec E-Flex ST. The product must be of a 
wall thickness that meets or exceeds BCA/NCC requirements and AS/NZS 2712:2007.
